progressLog.reason: The candidate's underlying revenue-gap evidence is present in Merchant Memory, but the required live Shopify predicates for the proposed intervention were not confirmed: the products query returned zero nodes for both named products. No safe, reversible Shopify merchandising write can be recommended without identifying the actual Shopify product records and confirming their current status, availability, and existing placement state.

The candidate's factual premise was not confirmed against current Shopify orders/customers in this turn. The only successful live read was a products query, which returned zero matching products and does not establish order-to-customer linkage. Additionally, no safe reversible Shopify Admin write operation was established for enabling customer identity capture and retroactively associating future orders.

The Shopify products query for the proposed anchor products “Borderlands Discovery Four” and “Cloud Needle Tsolikouri” executed successfully but returned zero product nodes. Current Shopify state therefore does not confirm the products needed to scope complementary recommendations or a bundle. Historical evidence shows median items per order of 1, 54% single-item orders, and 6% orders with four or more items, but those predicates alone do not identify currently valid Shopify resources for a safe reversible intervention.

The supporting evidence confirms historical momentum, but the required live Shopify predicates for a safe merchandising change were not established: the prior products query returned an empty node set for Borderlands Discovery Four and Cloud Needle Tsolikouri, and no collection/storefront ordering state was read. Therefore the intervention cannot be safely scoped or confirmed in this turn.

The successful Shopify products query returned zero matching nodes, so the two affected variants cannot be identified or verified from current Shopify state. In addition, replenishment quantities and approved in-stock alternatives are not available in Shopify. Checked operation: products, with product status, total inventory, variant inventory quantity, available-for-sale status, and price requested. Candidate disposition: BLOCKED_BY_EVIDENCE.

The Shopify state confirms the premise: 25 variants across 17 ACTIVE products were read successfully, and all 25 inventoryItem.unitCost values are null. However, Shopify cannot provide authoritative supplier purchase costs. A complete merchant-confirmed cost mapping for all 25 eligible variant IDs is required before any safe productVariantUpdate can be executed.
